title: Household
description: A social and economic unit of one or more persons who share food and other essentials for living. The operational definition varies across countries and programs, combining criteria of co-residence, shared budget, shared cooking, kinship, and administrative registration.

name.description: The full display name of the record. Depending on the concept, this is a person's or group's name, or the title of a program, instrument, scoring rule, or software product.

items.description: Identifiers carried by this entity, such as national ID numbers, program IDs, or identifiers asserted by an identity document.

Identity documents held by this party, such as passports, national identity cards, civil registration certificates, and program-issued beneficiary cards, or, for an organization, a certificate of registration.

group_type.description: An interoperability classifier for the category of group record being exchanged or exported. In native PublicSchema modeling, the concrete Group subtype is the authoritative signal when known.

formation_date.description: The date on which this group or organization was formed or registered.

member_count.description: The total number of members in this household or group.

items.description: The membership links connecting persons to this group, each carrying role and lifecycle dates.

address.description: The physical or postal address associated with this household.

location.description: The geographic location of the subject of this record, captured as coordinates or administrative area.

food_security_level.description: A coarse current-state summary of the household's food insecurity, used by operational systems for targeting and referral queries. This is NOT the raw output of a specific food-security assessment instrument: item-level responses (FCS, rCSI, LCS, HDDS, FIES, HHS, MDD-W, MAHFP) belong on a dedicated food-security profile published in a sibling schema (see ADR-011). Populate food_security_level from a Profile only by citing the instrument and cutoff rule that produced the band via a ScoringEvent; otherwise treat it as a self-declared or enumerator-judged summary.

pregnant_or_lactating_count.description: The number of pregnant or lactating women currently living in the household. Used by humanitarian programs to size nutrition, health, and protection interventions (PLW-targeted food rations, antenatal care outreach, MIYCN counselling). Recorded at household level because the eligibility unit for most PLW programming is the household, not the individual; an individual-level pregnancy_status property is also available on Person for case-management workflows.

chronic_illness_in_household.description: Whether any household member is reported to have a chronic illness or long-term medical condition (e.g. hypertension, diabetes, HIV, TB, asthma). Recorded at household level for vulnerability triage and case-management referral; the specific condition and the affected member are recorded on Person-scoped or program-specific records, not here.
